_lifecycle: PROVISIONAL (n=1-5) -> ACTIVE (n>=8, directionally consistent) -> CONFIRMED (n>=20 or n>=30/class) -> RETIRED. Only CONFIRMED entries may become an operative output rule (D11).

lessons.lesson: Don't overrate hosts/favorites; keep win probability at the (power-corrected) devigged line.
Even matchups carry heavy draw mass -- don't overprice either win or star-player goals.
+2-3 to the stronger-on-paper side in technically even matchups (post KOR upset). n still ~1-2 effective; revisit at n>=5 even-matchup wins.

lessons.grade: CONFIRMED (n=32 @118, avg Brier 0.248 vs self-exp 0.227, +0.021 within noise)
lessons.lesson: Strict 'more than' markets lose on ties -- use section 5.4 exact table; crowd's tie-blind 50 is the richest well.
Player 1+ SOT >> player goal as a value market.

lessons.grade: CONFIRMED (n~5 @118, ~20% vs ~31% prior on tiny noisy n)
lessons.lesson: Penalty/red markets are noise; stay near base rates; absorb bad Briers without reaction.
T-floor for technical even matchups: never let fundamentals drag T >0.1 below anchor-implied; no-anchor cases get +0.2-0.3 technical-depth bump. Read BTTS-and-3+ off the grid, never below it.
Striker 1+ SOT: discount inside team lambda allocation (not final output) under rotation risk so all derived props stay coherent with anchored team totals. Mandatory Depth Pass post-lineup.

Correlation cap: >4 markets on one latent axis -> proactive batched MC integration over parameter uncertainty for near-horizon matches, with <=3pt logged uncertainty adjustment as fallback. Never manual output flattening. Risk unit = per-match swing.
HT-tied ceiling 47 unless anchor-implied T < 2.2 (Bessel table section 5.5).

lessons.grade: ACTIVE (n=18, crosses section 9.4 n>=8 directional bar)
lessons.lesson: 56-70% probability band runs hot (overpriced). @118: n=18, hit 44.4% vs avg predicted 61.2% -> gap -16.8pt. Corrective is input-side only: section 5.6 main-striker 1+SOT band lowered 60-72 -> 52-64; any modeled p in the top half of 56-70 now requires an explicit written driver, else regress to the lower band edge. No output ceiling.

50-55% probability band runs cold (underpriced). @118: n=13, hit 61.5% vs avg predicted 53.3% -> +8.2pt (was +17.4 at n=7). Mirror of L10; an anchor/devig question, not a shading question -- do not bump outputs.

Win markets (archetype #1) run hot. @118: n=10, avg Brier 0.303 vs self-expected 0.209, hit 70%. Symmetric pattern -- low-p underdogs over-winning and modest favourites not winning. Corrective is input-side: hardened Dixon-Coles + overdispersion draw inflation in the 40-60 win band, marginally more fundamentals weight there. Not a floor, not an output shade (the @79 'raise underdog win floors' proposal stays REJECTED per D11).
Performance ranking must be RBP-first, not raw-Brier-first. CAN-BIH is the canonical correction: best match because it scored +60.67 RBP, not merely because its avg Brier was ~0.179.

Goal counts are mildly overdispersed vs pure Poisson (Goldman evidence): ~1,200 excess goalless team-games and ~566 excess 4+ games in ~20k internationals (lambda~1.305). Captured as small documented tilts in section 5.2.1 (capped +/-3, merged with Dixon-Coles -- do not double-count).

lessons.grade: ACTIVE as a research-allocation signal only
lessons.lesson: Favourite-longshot crowd bias is structural: the crowd spreads probability down the field, over-pricing salient mid-tier names/teams and under-pricing the dominant favourite and boring high-probability outcomes. Never a fade rule -- flag STRONG, confirm true p, submit p (D2).

prime_directives_reference.D2: Calibration is the strategy -- never shade the final submitted probability, including audit-derived floors/ceilings (see D11).
prime_directives_reference.D11: Audit-overcorrection guardrail: a new ledger entry may be proposed at PROVISIONAL with stated n/direction, but may not become an operative rule (floor/ceiling/band-wide shift) until it clears ACTIVE (n>=8 directional) then CONFIRMED (n>=20 or n>=30/class).
prime_directives_reference.D12: RBP-first performance objective: rank realized performance by weighted RBP, not raw Brier. D2 still dominates what gets submitted.
